The '''Sooma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sooma]],<ref name="Lost in Time" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sooman]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated, Part 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sooma system first appeared, albeit unidentified, in [[Droids (1986) 4|''Droids'' (1986) 4]], the fourth issue of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] comic series published by [[Star Comics]], an imprint of [[Marvel Comics]],<ref name="Lost in Time" /> which was first published on [[October 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="Lost in Time publication date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54154/star_wars_droids_1986_4|text=Star Wars: Droids (1986) #4}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square R-6.<ref name="TEA" />
